outcome: Transient evoked otoacoustic emissions (TEOAE) pass rate
Automated auditory brainstem response (AABR) failure rate
finding: Neonates born via cesarean section had higher rates of failing TEOAE and screening AABR examinations compared to those born vaginally.
mod_finding: The rates of failing the TEOAE and screening AABR examinations were higher among neonates born by CS compared to VB.
